title: DBGuardAI snapshot schema (version 0.3.0)
description: Contract for snapshot bundles. Version 0.3.0 extends v0.2.0 by adding a checks object keyed by spec_id to record assessment results for each spec.

envelope.description: The v0.2.0 envelope with collector metadata. This is unchanged from 0.2.0.

baseline.description: The v0.2.0 bundle body (all sections: roles, settings, hba_rules, etc.). This represents the baseline snapshot without assessment.

checks.description: Assessment results keyed by spec_id. Each spec_id must match a spec in the benchmark spec set.

schema_version.description: Must be '0.2.0' for the baseline envelope.

baseline.description: The v0.2.0 bundle body - all sections from the collector. Keys are section names, values are arrays or objects depending on the section.

check_entry.description: A single assessment check result for one spec.

spec_hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the spec that generated this check.

query.description: The query or command that was executed.

status.description: Result status: ok (success), error, or not_collected.

result.description: Raw result when status is 'ok'. Empty arrays/objects are valid results.

error.description: Error message when status is 'error'. Required when status is error.
